name: mbar_phase_reuse
desc: mbarrier reused across a loop (FA3-mainloop pattern): one mbarrier is arrived+waited once per iteration so its phase parity flips and is REUSED each iteration. Single warp; each iteration writes a shared slot, the barrier orders all 32 writes, then each lane reads its neighbor's slot (cross-lane data gated by the barrier) and accumulates. Tests phase reuse + cross-lane ordering that the single-cycle mbar_prod_cons does not. Toggle-free real mbarrier.
